text.value:
@concat('INSERT INTO [dbo].[ADFExtFileLogs]  ([PipelineName]  ,[RunId]  ,[ExternalFilename]  ,[VersionNo]  ,[Archive_location]  ,[Uploaded_by]  ,[SourceRecords]  ,[CreatedDateTime]) ',
' SELECT ''',pipeline().Pipeline,''' as PipelineName, ''',pipeline().RunId,''' as RunId, ''',item().name,''' as SrcFileName,'''
,string(add(int(activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters_2').output.firstRow.version_no),1)),''' as VersionNo, '''
,concat(activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters_2').output.firstRow.folder_path,'/',formatDateTime(utcnow(),'yyyy'),'/',formatDateTime(utcnow(),'MM'),'/',formatDateTime(utcnow(),'dd'),'/','VersionNo-',string(add(int(activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters_2').output.firstRow.version_no),1)), '_', formatDateTime(utcnow(),'yyyy-MM-dd THHmmss'),'_', item().name),''' as Archive
, NULL as UploadedBy,''', 
activity('cp_copy_from_network_to_blob').output.rowsRead ,
'''as RecordCount,''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters_2').output.firstRow.run_start_datetime,''' as CreatedDateTime')
